Child group of R10-CI-LAYOUT (copied from R10-CI-LAYOUT's brief and issue #2495, tvofi/heatpump_optimizer): this group is PR 2 of the four-PR sequence PR 0, PR G, PR 1, PR 2, and nothing else; PR 1 must merge first (after: R10-CI-LAYOUT-P1). CI consolidation of .github/workflows/tests.yml under one umbrella workflow and one required check, in FOUR pull requests, in this order: PR 0, PR G, PR 1, PR 2. D-5 keep CodeQL's O17 stand-down with its soundness check. R-10 option B: pr-contract lists open code-scanning alerts of the matched analyses, the lag wait is dropped, and U6 shows a planted python-only finding listed; the pr-contract change is policy and needs the owner's approval.

Must-fix from the round-5 review (this programme defers nothing): N5-1, the driver keys on run attempts, not status transitions: for each run read each attempt up to run_attempt not yet swept (only attempt 1 under --nochain, every attempt under --chain) and log any attempt first seen already superseded. N5-2, the dismissed-alert subtraction reads by ref: for each alert number left after the base subtraction read the alert itself and drop it if its state is dismissed (alert-level, no ref), or add to U6 case 5 a dismissal made after case 4's upload. N5-3, pin the analyses listing's sort and direction parameters explicitly, in the entities.py row; say in R-10 that the same-M hand-upload residual is dominated by dismissal (same write grant); optionally record the severity spread of listed alerts in U6 case 6. N5-4, reword 4.3 to 'requested and not completed (queued, waiting, pending, requested or in_progress)'.

Ruleset cut-over: moving the main ruleset's required checks to the single gate check is a repository security setting and tvofi's own action, never the seat's or the orchestrator's. The phase 2 pull request stages it as an owner step: the exact command (the ruleset update call with the full payload, derived from the live ruleset JSON read at that time) and a rollback (the saved prior JSON and its restore call), both tested read-only in the body.

Identity and flow: the seat pushes refs only, through tools/audit/seat/handoff_push.sh and tools/audit/seat/bus.sh; every GitHub write is the orchestrator's (decisions 0011 and 0013). Work from fresh origin/main in your own worktree under your ABSOLUTE scratch directory; stop only PIDs you started. Every figure above is a snapshot at the finding's baseline: re-derive it at your merge base. Owner gate: see owner_gate (code-owned CI workflows, tests/run.sh for PR 0, and policy in PR 1 and PR 2); each PR is approved by the CODEOWNER session under mandate 6175172275.
